about: EXT19 machine-readable contract for high-risk operations. The client state machine (assets/app/he-ops.js) must equal 'states' / 'strict' / 'repeatable' exactly (tests/specs/state-contract-ext19.spec.js). Each operation names how a duplicate or stale action is stopped and which tests prove it. CURRENT on the feature branch; database claims marked R1-R5 need the drafts installed in production (NOT installed).

vocabulary.READY: nothing in flight; a person may start
vocabulary.VALIDATING: checking the form before sending; nothing sent
vocabulary.CONFIRMED: the database said it was done
vocabulary.FAILED_BEFORE_EFFECT: refused or failed before any change; safe to try again
vocabulary.RESULT_UNKNOWN: the reply was lost; it may or may not have been saved; never re-sent automatically
vocabulary.READBACK_CHECKING: a person asked to check; the page reads the record back
vocabulary.RESOLVED: the read-back decided; safe to start again
vocabulary.CONFLICT: someone else changed it first; nothing overwritten
vocabulary.SESSION_EXPIRED: sign-in ended; nothing claimed as saved
vocabulary.PERMISSION_DENIED: not allowed for this person; not a technical failure

invariants: RESULT_UNKNOWN leaves only through READBACK_CHECKING (plus SENDING for a database step that itself refuses duplicates)
no state goes from SENDING straight back to READY
CONFIRMED is final for a one-time operation
every state except CONFIRMED has a way back to READY

operations.name: Receive a purchase order
operations.database: status compare-and-set; R1 receive_purchase_order when installed

operations.name: Manual stock adjustment
operations.database: stale-value check; R4 adjust_inventory when installed

operations.name: Return status / receive / restock
operations.database: updateIfUnchanged('returns', …) claim; R3 receive_return when installed

operations.name: Recall quarantine
operations.database: updateIfUnchanged('recalls', …) claim; R2 quarantine_recall when installed

operations.name: Delete an unused product
operations.database: R5 delete_unused_product when installed (re-checks under the product lock)
